Lemma
[first variation of Perelman's F-functional] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 1.5.2\group Cao–Zhu Variational Structure and Dynamic Property For $v_{ij}=\delta g_{ij}$, $h=\delta f$, and $v=g^{ij}v_{ij}$, \[ \delta \mathcal F(v,h)=\int _M\left[-v_{ij}(R_{ij}+ abla _i abla _jf) +\left( rac v2-h ight)(2\Delta f-| abla f|^2+R) ight]e^{-f}\dd V. \]
Proof

\sketch Use $\delta R=-\Delta v+ abla _i abla _jv_{ij}-R_{ij}v_{ij}$, differentiate the weighted volume form, and integrate by parts against $e^{-f}$.
